en.name: Vanguard
en.ability: Each night* before Judgment Day, choose: you can't die tonight, or your 2 alive neighbours can't die tonight.

revisions.v1: Each night* before Judgment Day, choose: you can't die tonight, or your 2 alive neighbours can't die tonight.

en.otherNightReminder: The Vanguard points to themself or to their neighbours.
